fieldNotes.truckGate: Single access road runs ~0.4km from Trade Water Pkwy through a wooded buffer into the truck yard. At the yard throat (33.7144,-84.5993) the entry is an open paved connection — no barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch-point checkpoint resolved in z19/z20 satellite, and the 2019/2025 Street View approaches show open roadway. Chain-link perimeter fencing IS present along the south property line (visible in Street View), so the lot is fenced but the truck entrance itself reads as uncontrolled. Flagged uncertain — a manned gate could exist beyond Street View reach.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No 1-3-space guard booth structure visible beside the yard entrance in satellite. The only small structures at the east end are the office/employee-parking block.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Double-loaded cross-dock: dock doors with trailers backed in along BOTH the north building face (facing the drop yard) and the south building face — two physically separate dock banks.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large paved drop yard north of the building holds 40+ trailers in angled rows without tractors, plus an additional trailer-storage strip further north; clearly a dedicated drop lot separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Gate-to-dock approach is a long wooded access road plus a deep internal yard; easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the dense Fulton County / Union City logistics corridor SW of Atlanta — surrounded by dozens of large warehouses. Urban industrial fabric.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimated ~70 doors across both faces from z18-z19 imagery (north face the primary bank); overhead estimate, banded 50+.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Approach road is ~2 lanes wide at the yard mouth; estimate 2 in / 2 out through the same throat. Not separately striped — estimate.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; building is bounded by a creek and wooded buffer on the west/south.
